name: @usdk/driver-robotics-sim
description: A simulated robotics driver - no physical hardware. Represents proposed movements as structured, bounded actions (see @usdk/capability-robotics), re-validates bounds at execution time, and implements a real emergencyStop() that bypasses deliberation and cancels pending movement. Physical hardware integration would require a separate, explicit driver with device capabilities/connection permissions/limits/acknowledgement rules - not implemented here, see docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md.
